attr.title: Ittle Dew
attr.desc: A short and sweet puzzle adventure. Ittle and her fairy fox Tippsie wash up on an island full of monsters, dungeons and treasure, and set out to find it all.
attr.inst: Any GOG or Steam version (Linux, Windows or Mac). GOG: copy the installer (.sh, .exe or .dmg) into ports/ittledew/gamedata. Steam: copy the game's files (Windows: dew.exe and dew_Data; Mac: IttleDew.app; Linux: IttleDew.x86 and IttleDew_Data) into ports/ittledew/gamedata.
